title: Mapping preserves program cost
statement: Let a deterministic query program have outputs in a type $A$, let $f:A\to B$ be any function, and let an oracle assign an answer to each query. Running the program obtained by applying $f$ to its output returns $f$ of the original run's output and exactly the same learning cost.
hypotheses_covered: function from the program's output type to a result type
